review: Zen Move / Rotate / Scale toolbar contrast over a bright viewport
classification: Inherited visual limitation within the observed and source-equivalent scope
verdict: The pale transform glyphs have poor contrast against their translucent bed over white. Source comparison supports an inherited paint policy, rather than a new Blender 5.3 change. The fixture draws underneath the overlapping toolbar region, not over its glyphs.

method.pixel_sampling: Read original PNG pixels using Pillow without altering the images

source_equivalence.hash_scope: UTF-8 bytes from the static void declaration through its matching closing brace, excluding the following newline
additional_checks: zen_toolbar_tool and zen_glass_cell are also byte-identical between the baseline and current source.
The Python toolbar layout in view3d_header_filter.py is unchanged.
The PILL token file differs only by a Blender header include rename; the token values are unchanged.
The glass draw implementation differs only by Blender header include renames.
The same function hash was independently verified at the observed Mac screenshot runtime 1a9e791e3; current_product 58b795ae6 identifies the source comparison tip, not the screenshot runtime.

mac_original.coordinate_system: Original image pixels; origin at top left

pixels.label: Toolbar bed beside the Rotate glyph

mac_original.contrast_method: sRGB relative luminance: linearize channels, weight 0.2126 / 0.7152 / 0.0722, then (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05)
mac_original.measurement_limit: Representative pixels corroborate the visual finding; this is not a complete glyph mask measurement or a formal accessibility audit. Bounds are visual inspection bounds, not semantic widget geometry.

earlier_linux_original.observation: The same pale transform column is visibly weak against the white viewport. This corroborates cross-platform scope; the earlier compositor pass did not specifically qualify transform glyph contrast.

paint_policy_evidence.finding: floats_over_content is true only for an explicit GlassTool component. Other Zen glass cells, including toolbar tools, receive the manual 0.20 gray wash and style.draw_tint is false.
PILL uses neutral gray tint values and defines fallback_alpha = 0.74; the toolbar tint-off branch bypasses that floor.
The no-backdrop fallback floor is applied to tint alpha only when style.draw_tint is true.

The existing tests explicitly preserve the 0.20 toolbar wash and tint-off policy. The test at line 154 reserves the stronger readability floor for explicit GlassTool capsules. Both policies already exist in the 5.2 baseline.

draw_order_evidence.finding: The white fixture registers only on SpaceView3D WINDOW POST_PIXEL. Its draw callback sets blend NONE and paints an opaque rectangle in that region.
POST_PIXEL callbacks run inside drawing of their own region.
The floating Zen tools predicate identifies an overlapping TOOLS region, separate from WINDOW.
Non-overlapping regions are composited first. Overlapping regions, including TOOLS, are blended later at lines 1334–1342.
Region blending explicitly selects GPU_BLEND_ALPHA_PREMULT, so the earlier fixture blend NONE does not determine toolbar region composition.

limits: No Blender 5.2 runtime comparison was performed; inherited classification rests on exact relevant source equivalence plus current native visual evidence.
No non-fixture normal Solid white-background replay was performed.
No hover, selected-state or disabled-state contrast matrix was measured in this investigation.
This report does not invalidate the separate island compositor proofs or extend those proofs to transform toolbar contrast.
optional_future_characterization: Remove the QA backdrop handler and use the normal Solid viewport background set to white, then compare white / dark / checker scenes with inactive, hovered and selected Move / Rotate / Scale controls. This would independently characterize the normal scene path; it has not been executed or proven by this review.
